test_title: PYST 34: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 29 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: If D can do 10 percent of a work in 3 days, then D can complete the entire work in how many days?
solution:
**Given:**

D can complete 10% of the work in 3 days.

**Formula used:**

Total days to complete the entire work = (100 / Percentage of work done) × Days taken

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total days = (100 / 10) × 3

⇒ Total days = 10 × 3

⇒ Total days = 30

**∴ D can complete the entire work in 30 days.**
